newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber flat, SIR10 down.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia late SIR20 rubber flat, SIR10 down.

text.p: Indonesian benchmark tyre-grade SIR20 offer prices were flat in late trading on Friday while SIR10 fell after U.S. buying in Medan, dealers said.
"There are some fresh enquiries for SIR20 as Tokyo market resumes trading today after a public holiday on Thursday," one Medan-based dealer said.

Dealers said SIR20 offer prices for November/December deliveries were at 55.00-55.50 U.S. cents/lb fob Medan and at 54.50-55.25 cents fob Palembang, Surabaya and Padang, and at 54.50-54.75 cents fob Jambi and Pontianak.
Another dealer said he sold SIR10 at 120.5 cents/kg fob Medan for November deliveries late on Thursday, with offtakes in small quantities. He said his previous deal was at 140 cents/kg.
SIR20 was last traded at 54.50 cents/lb fob Palembang late on Wednesday for November deliveries to the United States, he said.
They said an earthquake that rocked North Sumatra last night did not seem to have any impact on plantations in the area.
High amoniac grade latex with 60 percent dry rubber content was last traded at 2,230 rupiah/kg against the previous 2,250 rupiah in the local markets of Bandung and Tangerang, they said.
